bath30g bicarbonate of soda1 tsp coarse saltMix the flour, yeast, sugar, fine salt and warm water into a dough.Knead until smooth and elastic.Cover and rise until doubled.Shape into small pretzels.Simmer the water with the bicarbonate of soda and bathe each pretzel briefly, then drain onto a lined tray and sprinkle with coarse salt.Bake at 220°C conventional until deep golden.Street corn on the cobBoiled then charred corn rolled in butter and flaky salt.How to make it4 small corn cobs30g butter, softened1/2 tsp sea salt flakesBoil the corn in water.Drain, then char on a hot grill, turning often.Roll in the softened butter and sprinkle with sea salt.Lodging house cinnamon breakfast bunsThe boys' breakfast before they head out to sell the papesHow to make itAs written, serves 4Soft milk buns rolled with butter, brown sugar and cinnamon, baked golden and glazed with vanilla icing.Mix 500g bread flour, 7g yeast, 50g sugar, 1 tsp salt, 250ml warm milk, 1 egg and 50g soft butter, knead 8 minutes and rise 1 hour.Roll to 40 x 30cm, spread with 60g butter and 100g brown sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon.Roll up, cut 12 buns and rise 30 minutes.Bake at 190°C for 22 minutes.Glaze with 120g icing sugar mixed with milk and vanilla.Pickled herring on ryeA bite before Brooklyn shows up.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsBrooklyn hot heat until blistered and piping hot.Steam the buns until warm.Fill each bun with a frank, mustard and sauerkraut, then wrap in food-safe paper.Lodging house Irish stewThe boys' dinner at the lodging houseHow to make itLamb neck chops browned, layered with potato, onion and carrot, stock poured over, braised covered at 160°C for 2 hours.Parsley.SweetsApple turnoversGolden puff pastry parcels golden.DrinksSarsaparilla ice cream spidersSarsaparilla poured over vanilla ice cream in tall glasses until it fizzes up into a creamy foam.How to make it8 scoops of vanilla ice cream1 L sarsaparilla,
